analysis.summary: Of 19 members, 10 stated intent to buy the 328 HKD member fare (all within budget, with 410 HKD regular as fallback except MEM-20261114-00003). Nine declined: six cited no ticket both available and within budget, two cited route/date mismatch, one cited unconfirmed companions. No inventory denials occurred and quota was not binding. These are stated intentions, not fulfilled purchases; declines reflect availability or fit rather than pure price objection.
analysis.hypothesis: Among members whose stated budget exceeds 410 HKD, raising the member fare toward 410 HKD will not reduce stated member-fare purchase intent, since most buyers cite ample budget headroom; test at an untested higher member price.
